schema_changelog.change: Cadence split: airport_monthly is domestic-only (international moved to airport_international_quarterly with a real quarter column). Dropped 'category' from airport_monthly and 'tier' from all tables. Passenger columns are integers.

New directed route table at (year, month, origin, destination) grain: each DGCA city pair splits into City1->City2 = PaxToCity2 and City2->City1 = PaxFromCity2, endpoints resolved through the validity-window resolver, explicit zero directions kept. A route needs both endpoints resolved and distinct; airport_monthly keeps its independent endpoint-level attribution, so route endpoint sums are a subset of airport endpoint sums (asserted by validation), never a replacement.
